ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a rectified voltage-regulated circuit. On the left side there is transformer T, a bridge rectifier composed of VD1～VD4, and filter capacitor C; in the upper middle is the three-terminal voltage regulator W7805, labeled with pins 1, 2, and 3, of which the right-side pin 3 is connected to the output terminal. On the right side there is a series voltage-divider network from the output terminal to ground: R1=3.3 kΩ, variable resistor Rp=5.1 kΩ, R2=3.3 kΩ, and the output voltage Uo is marked between the upper and lower ends of this path; the sliding terminal of Rp is connected into the feedback/reference node. The problem statement explains that the slider of Rp is at the middle position. Reasoning: When the slider is in the middle, Rp is divided into two equal parts, each part being 5.1/2=2.55 kΩ. The resistance from the upper end of Uo to the slider is R1+the upper half of Rp=3.3+2.55=5.85 kΩ; the resistance from the slider to ground is the lower half of Rp+R2=2.55+3.3=5.85 kΩ. Therefore the slider potential is half of the output voltage, namely Us=Uo/2. W7805 keeps its output terminal 5 V higher than the common/reference terminal, so Uo-Us=5 V. Substituting Us=Uo/2 gives Uo-Uo/2=5 V, namely Uo=10 V.

raw_record.question_text: In the voltage regulator circuit shown in the figure, when the slider of the variable resistor is in the middle position, the output voltage \(U_o\) is ________ V.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the W7805 regulator, the right-side divider R1–Rp–R2, the output terminals, and the fact that Rp’s slider is at the middle. Then split Rp into two equal parts of 2.55 kΩ. The resistance from Uo down to the slider is 3.3 kΩ + 2.55 kΩ, and the resistance from the slider to ground is 2.55 kΩ + 3.3 kΩ, so the slider voltage is Uo/2. The W7805 keeps its output pin 5 V above its common/reference pin, and the feedback makes the slider/reference node 5 V below the output. Therefore Uo - Uo/2 = 5 V, giving Uo = 10 V.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个整流后稳压电路，左侧有变压器 T、由 VD1～VD4 组成的桥式整流和滤波电容 C；中上部是三端稳压器 W7805，标有 1、2、3 引脚，其中右侧 3 脚接到输出端。右侧有从输出端到地的串联分压网络：R1=3.3 kΩ、可变电阻 Rp=5.1 kΩ、R2=3.3 kΩ，输出电压 Uo 标在这条上下端之间；Rp 的滑动端接入反馈/参考节点。题设说明 Rp 的滑片在中间位置。推理：滑片在中间时，Rp 被分成两个相等部分，每部分为 5.1/2=2.55 kΩ。从 Uo 上端到滑片的电阻为 R1+Rp上半部=3.3+2.55=5.85 kΩ；从滑片到地的电阻为 Rp下半部+R2=2.55+3.3=5.85 kΩ。因此滑片电位是输出电压的一半，即 Us=Uo/2。W7805 保持其输出端比公共/参考端高 5 V，所以 Uo-Us=5 V。代入 Us=Uo/2，得 Uo-Uo/2=5 V，即 Uo=10 V。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the circuit diagram: a W7805 three-terminal regulator has its output at pin 3 feeding the top output node; the output voltage Uo is measured from this top node to the bottom ground rail. A feedback/divider chain on the right consists of R1 = 3.3 kΩ, variable resistor Rp = 5.1 kΩ, and R2 = 3.3 kΩ in series between Uo and ground. The slider of Rp is connected into the regulator/op-amp feedback network, and pin 2 of the W7805 is the reference/common pin controlled by that feedback.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text to know the requested quantity is the numeric output voltage Uo in volts under the condition that the variable-resistor slider is in the middle position.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the ideal 7805 rule that it maintains about 5 V between pin 3 output and pin 2 common/reference. With the slider in the middle, Rp is split equally, so the feedback tap is at the electrical midpoint because the resistance above the tap is R1 + Rp/2 and below it is Rp/2 + R2; since R1 = R2, these two resistances are equal.
